Development & real assets

Technology meets the ground.

Terranile is exploring physical development and real-asset models alongside its technology and research initiatives.

Terranile DevelopmentExploratory
Approach

Build around the asset, not only around the software.

One approach brings landowners and development partners into a shared development structure. Land can be contributed, a concept designed and marketed, and properties sold with value shared according to the development agreement.

Landowner participation

Explore structures in which land contributes to a development project.

Development partnerships

Bring development concepts and partners together around a defined asset.

Design and marketing

Develop project concepts and approaches to presenting them to prospective buyers.

Agreed value sharing

Proceeds and value are allocated according to the specific development agreement.

These are exploratory models. No completed developments, approved investments or active land opportunities are represented on this website.
